units.source_text: 这岩前的松树，仔细看来，确是精妙的造物。

en.t: When one looked closely, the pine tree before this rock was indeed a wonderfully exquisite creation.

units.source_text: 秋好皇后看了诗，觉得紫姬如此善于即兴拈题，甚可赞佩。

en.t: After reading the poem, Empress Akikonomu felt that Lady Murasaki's skill at composing so aptly on the spur of the moment was truly admirable.

units.source_text: 源氏对紫姬说：“皇后送你这红叶与诗，有点令人不快。

en.t: Genji said to Lady Murasaki, "It is a little vexing that the Empress sent you these autumn leaves and a poem.

units.source_text: 等到春花盛开时，你可报复她了。

en.t: When the spring blossoms are in full bloom, you may take your revenge on her.

units.source_text: 现在贬斥红叶，对不起立田姬，你且忍受了吧。

en.t: To disparage the autumn leaves now would be unfair to Princess Tatsuta, so you must bear it for the time being.

units.source_text: 将来站在樱花荫下，你便可逞强了。”

en.t: Someday, standing beneath the shade of the cherry blossoms, you will be able to make your proud reply."

units.source_text: 夫妇嬉笑闲谈的光景，真有无限生趣，教人不胜艳羡。

en.t: The sight of the husband and wife laughing and chatting together was full of endless charm, enough to make anyone deeply envious.

units.source_text: 这六条院确是最理想的住处，诸位夫人和睦相处，时时互通音问。

en.t: Rokujo-in was indeed the most ideal residence, where all the ladies lived in harmony and often exchanged messages with one another.
